items.datafile: }} Acidic Concoction is an item that can be found only during Mutant Questline in Kirill's Laboratory. Player can find five of theses canisters in the upper lab and one in the basement. Consuming it will alter your Acid Spray and Acid Blob Attack abilities to inflict rusting acid upon use (applies Rusting debuff and Acid damage is increased by 35% against vehicles and machines). == Effect == {{Status Effect Infobox
